<!-- Parameters. branchRates has no lower bound: with nonCentered="true" it holds N(0,1) deviates. --> <parameter id="MTSMclockRate.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" lower="0">1</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" lower="0">0.5</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" dimension="1">1</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" lower="0">0.01</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMspikeMeanPriorMean.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" lower="0" estimate="false">0.01</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" lower="0.2">2</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.RealParameter" name="stateNode" lower="0" dimension="1">1</parameter> <parameter id="MTSMindicator.c:$(n)" spec="parameter.BooleanParameter" name="stateNode" estimate="false">1</parameter>
<!-- Clock model --> <branchRateModel id="MultiTypeSpikeClock.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.clockmodel.PunctuatedClockModel" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" clock.rate="@MTSMclockRate.c:$(n)" rates="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" rateSD="@MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" spikeMean="@MTSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" indicator="@MTSMindicator.c:$(n)" relaxed="true"/>
<!-- Spike prior; linked to the BDMM-Prime tree prior by the bdmDistr connector below --> <prior id="MTSMbranchSpikePrior.c:$(n)" name="distribution" spec="multitypespike.distribution.BranchSpikePrior" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" spikeShape="@MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)"/>
<!-- Priors --> <prior id="MTSMclockRatePrior.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMclockRate.c:$(n)"> <Gamma name="distr"> <parameter name="alpha" value="10" estimate="false" lower="0"/> <parameter name="beta" value="0.01" estimate="false" lower="0"/> </Gamma> </prior> <prior id="MTSMclockSDPrior.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)"> <Gamma name="distr"> <parameter name="alpha" value="5" estimate="false" lower="0"/> <parameter name="beta" value="0.05" estimate="false" lower="0"/> </Gamma> </prior> <!-- Exactly one branch-rate prior is used, depending on nonCentered. The centred mean stays 1 for identifiability against the clock rate. --> <prior id="MTSMbranchRatePriorCentered.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)"> <LogNormal name="distr" meanInRealSpace="true" M="1" S="@MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)"/> </prior> <prior id="MTSMbranchRatePriorNonCentered.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)"> <Normal name="distr" mean="0" sigma="1"/> </prior> <prior id="MTSMspikeMeanPrior.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMspikeMean.c:$(n)"> <LogNormal name="distr" meanInRealSpace="true" M="@MTSMspikeMeanPriorMean.c:$(n)"> <parameter name="S" value="0.6" estimate="false" lower="0"/> </LogNormal> </prior> <prior id="MTSMspikeMeanPriorMeanPrior.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMspikeMeanPriorMean.c:$(n)"> <Exponential name="distr"> <parameter name="mean" value="0.01" estimate="false" lower="0"/> </Exponential> </prior> <prior id="MTSMspikeShapePrior.c:$(n)" name="distribution" x="@MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)"> <LogNormal name="distr" meanInRealSpace="true"> <parameter name="M" value="2" estimate="false" lower="0"/> <parameter name="S" value="0.5" estimate="false" lower="0"/> </LogNormal> </prior>
<!-- Spike operators --> <operator id="MTSMSpikeFlipOperator.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.operator.SpikeFlipOperator" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" spikeShape="@MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" branchSpikePrior="@MTSMbranchSpikePrior.c:$(n)" weight="30.0"/> <operator id="MTSMTargetedSpikeOperator.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.operator.TargetedSpikeOperator" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" branchSpikePrior="@MTSMbranchSpikePrior.c:$(n)" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" weight="10.0"/> <!-- Assumes positive rate multipliers, so only used when nonCentered="false" --> <operator id="MTSMSpikeUpRateDown.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.operator.SpikeUpDownOperator" parameter="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" spikes="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="20.0"/> <operator id="MTSMlatentSpikesScale.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMlatentSpikes.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="30.0"/>
<!-- Parameter operators --> <operator id="MTSMclockRateScale.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMclockRate.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="MTSMclockSDScale.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMclockSD.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="MTSMspikeMeanScale.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMspikeMean.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="10.0"/> <operator id="MTSMspikeMeanPriorMeanScale.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMspikeMeanPriorMean.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="5.0"/> <operator id="MTSMspikeShapeScale.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMspikeShape.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="10.0"/> <operator id="MTSMBitFlipOperator.c:$(n)" spec="BitFlipOperator" uniform="true" parameter="@MTSMindicator.c:$(n)" weight="1.0"/>
<!-- Branch-rate operators; the scale operator is added below only when nonCentered="false" --> <operator id="MTSMAdaptableOperatorSamplerRatesInternal.c:$(n)" spec="AdaptableOperatorSampler" weight="20.0"> <parameter idref="MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)"/> <tree idref="Tree.t:$(n)"/> <operator id="MTSMORCRatesRandomWalk.c:tree.c:$(n)" spec="operator.kernel.BactrianRandomWalkOperator" parameter="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.1" weight="1.0"> <kernelDistribution spec="operator.kernel.KernelDistribution$Bactrian"/> </operator> </operator> <operator id="MTSMORCRatesScale.c:tree.c:$(n)" spec="kernel.BactrianScaleOperator" parameter="@MTSMbranchRates.c:$(n)" scaleFactor="0.5" upper="10.0" weight="1.0"> <kernelDistribution spec="operator.kernel.KernelDistribution$Bactrian"/> </operator>
<!-- Loggers --> <log id="MTSMrateStat.c:$(n)" spec="beast.base.evolution.RateStatistic" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" branchratemodel="@MultiTypeSpikeClock.c:$(n)"/> <log id="MTSMSaltativeProportionLogger.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.logger.SaltativeProportionLogger" tree="@Tree.t:$(n)" clock="@MultiTypeSpikeClock.c:$(n)"/> <log id="MTSMSpikeLogger.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.logger.SpikeLogger" clock="@MultiTypeSpikeClock.c:$(n)"/> <log id="MTSMHiddenEventsLogger.c:$(n)" spec="multitypespike.logger.HiddenEventsLogger" branchSpikePrior="@MTSMbranchSpikePrior.c:$(n)"/>
